note: SYNTHETIC personas and rights. One policy file drives the engine checks, the REST/MCP gate and the UI navigation. Capabilities are what a persona may DO; scope (knowledge bases) is WHERE. Nothing here is a Humana org chart.

capabilities.search: Ask a question and get an approved, cited, scoped answer
capabilities.get_unit: Open one approved unit by id (within entitlement)
capabilities.list_changes: See what changed in the knowledge they may read
capabilities.report_gap: Log a question the knowledge could not answer
capabilities.view_trace: See the 13-step reasoning trace behind an answer
capabilities.view_channel_compare: See the same unit rendered for every channel
capabilities.view_provenance: See owner, approver, version history and source section of a unit
capabilities.ingest_source: Upload a source document and run extraction (proposes only)
capabilities.propose_unit: Turn extraction candidates or a gap into a draft for review
capabilities.accept_merge_split: Accept a merge or split suggestion on a non-verbatim draft
capabilities.view_review_queue: See pending drafts in their scope
capabilities.approve_standard: Approve or reject non-legal units in their knowledge bases
capabilities.approve_legal: Approve, reject or edit verbatim and legally approved units
capabilities.view_owner_queue: See stale and conflict items for units they own
capabilities.resolve_owner_item: Claim and resolve stale and conflict items
capabilities.claim_gap: Claim a gap so two authors do not write the same unit
capabilities.view_search_insights: See what people searched for and what came back empty
capabilities.manage_access: Grant or revoke a role's access to a knowledge base
capabilities.view_access_matrix: See who may read which knowledge base
capabilities.view_audit: Read the audit log of proposals, decisions, access changes and denials
capabilities.view_call_log: Read the REST and MCP call log
capabilities.run_evals: Run the golden, blind and hold-out sets
capabilities.view_evals: Read eval results and release gates
capabilities.manage_agents: Register agent connections and bind each to a role
capabilities.view_analytics: See aggregate health metrics only: no unit bodies, no query text
capabilities.create_change_notice: Enter a formulary or notice-of-change update once and open a task for every affected unit
capabilities.reverify_unit: Attest that a unit is still correct and extend its review date (verbatim needs Legal)
capabilities.give_feedback: Rate an answer and flag it; a flag opens an item for the unit owner
capabilities.replay_answer: Reconstruct a past answer from its request id, and see which version was live on a date
capabilities.view_rights_matrix: See the persona by capability matrix and the separation-of-duties rules (read only)

pharmacy_advocate.label: Pharmacy advocate
pharmacy_advocate.who: Takes calls and chats about drugs, pharmacy benefits and prior authorization of medicines.
pharmacy_advocate.goal: Say the approved thing, quickly, with a citation, and know what to do when there is no answer.
pharmacy_advocate.cannot_see: Insurance knowledge base bodies, drafts, the audit log, other advocates' queries.
pharmacy_advocate.denied_example: Open the Author or Access pages: the pages are not offered and the API returns 403.

insurance_advocate.label: Insurance advocate
insurance_advocate.who: Takes calls and chats about plan benefits, eligibility, claims and ID cards.
insurance_advocate.goal: Same as the pharmacy advocate, on the insurance knowledge base.
insurance_advocate.cannot_see: Pharmacy knowledge base bodies. A pharmacy question returns not_authorized plus the owning team.
insurance_advocate.denied_example: Same denials as the pharmacy advocate.

advocate_supervisor.label: Advocate supervisor
advocate_supervisor.who: Team lead who takes the escalation when an advocate gets conflict, stale or no answer.
advocate_supervisor.goal: Unblock the advocate on the call, then make sure the gap reaches an owner.
advocate_supervisor.cannot_see: Drafts, approvals, access and audit. Sees the reasoning trace but cannot change anything.
advocate_supervisor.denied_example: Approve or edit a unit: denied.

member_chat.label: Member (self-service)
member_chat.who: A member asking in chat or by voice.
member_chat.goal: A plain, correct answer, or a warm hand-off to a person. Never a wrong or internal one.
member_chat.cannot_see: Advocate-only units, unit ids, owner teams, internal next steps, trace, anything not marked for the member audience.
member_chat.denied_example: A restricted question returns a hand-off, never the owner team or the unit title.

ai_agent.label: AI agent (downstream channel)
ai_agent.who: Voice bot, chat assistant or Agent Assist calling Verity as a tool.
ai_agent.goal: Ground every answer in an approved unit and insert legal verbatim by reference.
ai_agent.cannot_see: Anything outside the role bound to its connection. The role is fixed on the connection, never an argument.
ai_agent.denied_example: Cannot hold any authoring, approval or access capability, whatever its configuration says.

knowledge_author.label: Knowledge author (Knowledge Ops)
knowledge_author.who: Turns messy source documents into knowledge units and keeps them current.
knowledge_author.goal: Get correct units reviewed fast, and close the gaps people actually ask about.
knowledge_author.cannot_see: Knowledge bases outside their write scope, access settings, other people's audit detail.
knowledge_author.denied_example: Approve any unit, including their own: denied (maker-checker). Touch a verbatim unit: denied.

knowledge_owner.label: Knowledge owner (domain)
knowledge_owner.who: Accountable for one domain's units, such as Pharmacy Ops or Member Services.
knowledge_owner.goal: Approve non-legal changes, clear stale and conflict items, own the backlog of gaps.
knowledge_owner.cannot_see: Other domains' drafts. Legal-routed drafts are visible only as read-only context.
knowledge_owner.denied_example: Approve a verbatim or legal unit: denied. Approve a draft they proposed: denied.

legal_approver.label: Legal / Compliance approver
legal_approver.who: Owns every word that must be said exactly.
legal_approver.goal: Approve, edit or reject verbatim and legal wording, seeing exactly what changed and what it would break.
legal_approver.cannot_see: Access settings, eval controls. Cannot ingest or propose, so Legal never approves its own proposal.
legal_approver.denied_example: Grant access or upload a source: denied.

access_admin.label: Access administrator
access_admin.who: Grants and revokes which role may read which knowledge base.
access_admin.goal: Least privilege, with a named person and a reason on every change.
access_admin.cannot_see: Unit bodies, queries, drafts. Cannot search.
access_admin.denied_example: Search, approve, ingest or run evals: denied. Separation of duties: access and content never sit with one person.

compliance_auditor.label: Compliance auditor / QA
compliance_auditor.who: Checks that the system did what policy says, after the fact.
compliance_auditor.goal: Reconstruct any answer or publication: who, what, which version, which rule.
compliance_auditor.cannot_see: Nothing is hidden from them, and nothing is writable by them.
compliance_auditor.denied_example: Any write: approve, propose, ingest, access change, claim: denied. Read-only by construction.

ai_product_owner.label: AI product owner (platform)
ai_product_owner.who: Owns the platform, the evals and the release gates.
ai_product_owner.goal: Prove the system is safe to publish to, and see where it fails.
ai_product_owner.cannot_see: Cannot approve content or change access. A platform owner who could also publish would be marking their own homework.
ai_product_owner.denied_example: Approve a unit or change access: denied.

leadership.label: Operations leadership
leadership.who: Accountable for compliance findings, handle time and channel consistency.
leadership.goal: See whether the program is working: consistency, backlog age, verbatim compliance, review time.
leadership.cannot_see: Unit bodies, query text, drafts, audit rows. Aggregates only.
leadership.denied_example: Open any unit, queue or log: denied.
